in_marathi.name: Lohita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lohita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lohit’, meaning ‘reddish’, ‘crimson’, or ‘red’. This name is associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing prosperity, wealth, and happiness. In Hindu mythology, Lohita is also the name of a demoness, personifying desire, attachment, and passion.
